entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell is this? A fire?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How do we get through here?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: If you wish to pass through, you must[n]obtain a key.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you're giving us a clue? Where can we[n]find that key?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: It was stolen by thieves. They are lurking[n]in the city.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: I doubt you'll be able to reclaim it though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She sounds as condescending as you,[n]Mona.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: I'll be waiting, but I won't expect much...
